logp.method_description: The lipophilicity (log Po/w) of Ir(III) complexes were determined by the conventional flask-shaking method as reported in the literature.7 Here, log Po/w = log (Co/Cw) is defined as the logarithmic ratio of theIr(III) complex concentration in n-octanol to that in the water phase. For this, 0.5 mg of Ir(III) complexes were taken in 3 mL of 1:1 v/v mixture of n-octanol and water and mixed vigorously for 24 h. The mixture was then kept in a stationary state for an additional 24 h to reach saturation. The n-octanol and water phases were separated, centrifuged at 3000 rpm for 10 min and the supernatant was isolated. The concentration of Ir(III) complexes were then determined by UV-vis spectroscopy in both the n-octanol(Co) and water (Cw) phases to estimate the log Po/w values.
